scripts.audit: npm run audit:toolchain && npm audit --workspaces --include-workspace-root --audit-level=low && npm run audit:qs
scripts.build: npm run -w front-end build && npm run verify:analytics && npm run verify:preview && npm run -w back-end build && npm run release:metadata
scripts.build:netlify: npm run -w front-end build && npm run verify:analytics && npm run verify:preview && npm run release:metadata && node scripts/write-netlify-headers.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-eslint-import-x.mjs && simple-git-hooks && npm run -w front-end prepare
scripts.lint-server: npm run -w back-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end server
scripts.lint-serve: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w front-end serve
scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run -w front-end lint && npm run -w back-end lint
scripts.lint-fix: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end lint-fix
scripts.test:e2e: DISABLE_ANALYTICS=true NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=/api npm run build && playwright test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w front-end typecheck && npm run -w back-end typecheck
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules front-end/node_modules front-end/.nuxt front-end/.output back-end/node_modules back-end/dist
scripts.test: npm run check:build-toolchain && npm run check:toolchain-package && npm run test:build-toolchain && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/test-archiver-compat.mjs scripts/test-glob-compat.mjs scripts/test-braces-compat.mjs scripts/test-listhen-compat.mjs scripts/test-deepmerge-compat.mjs scripts/test-qs-compat.mjs scripts/test-vendored-qs-packaging.mjs scripts/test-vue-devtools-compat.mjs scripts/test-toolchain-compat.mjs scripts/test-native-bindings.mjs scripts/test-frontend-command.mjs scripts/test-devtools-provider.mjs && npm run -w back-end test && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_runtime_artifact.py -v && npm run test:devtools && npm run test:toolchain-package
scripts.up: taze major -I && npm run -w front-end up && npm run -w back-end up
scripts.audit:qs: npm audit --prefix vendor/qs --workspaces=false --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix vendor/qs --workspaces=false --omit=dev --audit-level=low

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: test -x ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged || { echo 'lint-staged is not installed. Run npm install.'; exit 1; }; ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged
